Title: Board of Trustees Annual Visit to the Academy
Excerpt: The PMAFI Board of Trustees made its annual visit to Fort del Pilar, meeting the Corps of Cadets and Academy personnel and reviewing the Foundation's support for PMA's faculty and facilities.

Title: Teaching Excellence Awardees Recognised
Excerpt: The Foundation joined the Academy in recognising members of the teaching staff for excellence in instruction, part of PMAFI's continuing support for faculty development at PMA.

Title: Alumni Present a Gift to the Foundation
Excerpt: Alumni of the Academy presented a donation to the Philippine Military Academy Foundation, to be applied to the fund they designated.
